In Nebraska, we know that E15 is a win-win-win.

It saves folks money at the pump, is good for the environment, and helps farmers get better prices for their crops.

In the Senate, we’re fighting to get year-round, nationwide E15 across the finish line.

Glad to join @Varneyco  to discuss two important topics—countering Communist China and year-round E15.
 
Staying ahead of Communist China in the AI race is critical to our national and economic security. Year-round E15 is critical to unleashing the power of American energy. I’m proud to champion both of these issues in the Senate.

posts.text:
A world where Communist China leads in AI is bad for the United States and for the entire world. It’s critical that we do not lose this race.
 
That’s why I introduced the MATCH Act. This bill ensures that Communist China and other adversaries cannot purchase key semiconductor manufacturing equipment (SME) technology from the United States or our allies.

Glad to see an extension for the Rural Community Hospital Demonstration (RCHD) pass the Senate. I cosponsored this effort because it is critical for healthcare access and sustainability  in our rural communities. This is how you keep rural communities thriving.


Nic Pottebaum (@NicDP)

Nebraska Hospital Assoc: “…That is why the Nebraska Hospital Association is grateful to the Senate for supporting the Rural Community Hospital Demonstration (RCHD) program.”

Last week I was in Singapore for the 2026 Shangri-La Dialogue.

Attending this conference is important to our national security and trade relations.

The U.S. must continue to demonstrate our commitment to deterring Chinese aggression. This ensures peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific. We should also work to expand our market access in this region for American farmers and ranchers.
